facts.business: Balaxi Pharmaceuticals Limited operates an integrated pharmaceutical platform focused on affordable access to essential medicines, generics, branded generics, and OTC products across Africa and Latin America through product registrations, local distribution networks, and a newly commissioned manufacturing facility at Jadcherla.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: Manufacturing licence received in May 2026; operations expected to commence in H1 of FY 2026-27

facts.related_party_note: During the year under review, the Company has entered into transactions with related parties, which are considered material, in accordance with the Company's Policy on dealing with Related Party Transactions and applicable laws. The transactions were in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis. However, there were no materially significant related party transactions which had potential conflict with the interests of the Company at large.
